book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 Korin Polna Mimirini Tombaimoa, Korinnindm Kolvrowolalm Kristusnindm, Noinda Ambo Sahonam Avnam Hev.

content: Manam Yimba Yutanindmsnamba Avav, Himba Temba Indkokla Vivna.

Seh, kava ninginv yemba, levrapivolalm, osm mani vina pina simbehumunilmba, temba himba nemetva engivnamba Mosesmba. Nonamba himba avna mendah tekokomonam, wo himba Wanplomb Aembulmba hovrahovra vituwelgina.
Wo di indkumbiva awothoprana, osva Mosesna towandal, vena, tekokomonam eva wanplombmera. Osm ora, doa hemba ponamba poswol vina Mosesna nihilnana.
Himba innemba mongawa inne noi hlana, Sesoasongol ten daswolnam.
Wo eva pomba hlana no mongawa po, ten Sesoasongol vrahunnam. Himba pomba hlana Sesoana hondini, ten mongawulm hevm wonlohvnam. Wo nomba honmba lehv Kristusm hevm.
Wo heva os owai, Sesoava hemba beswonamba monglamba nongalvnamoa. Wo noinda sihana hemba sahalpetharava.
Nomba temba venamba, pim osm vinna, nonora avra. Pimba olwilna, manam manam honamba petharinimba und velmba, osva temba no indhanamba vivnamba.
Wo eva yimba manam sembayang vinvra tihsongomba, osva monglava temba vivnamba himba. Men novol velohv doaramini tombaimora,

content.text: Doa avhoanamba, indhanamba innena pona nevna, tih lohvna. Doa vinamba, monglava tendona onganamba hevm aonglasongla vildengu vevna. Kisim Bek 32:6

content: Pimba manam ongariskuiva viwul vevra, osva temba himba monglava vivnamba. Mongawa okombanamba hemba mara os mueisowa venama 23,000 hevna lakapolara.
Pimba manam osva simbeihivav Kristusmba, osva temba himba monglava vinamba. Hemba monglamba saiholamindna singvevna.
Wo manam yimba Sesoamongova alhuvav, osva monglava temba himba vivnamba. Hemba monglamba helvakomo vena ovsongolnindrini, noi ten indhanakoklam helvakomo velohvm.

Nomba manimani temba nongallohnamba no indhanamba, ambo inethalm pim. Wo pimba novol veluhunv men honamba, osmba manam pimba osva vivav. Manara, daipotava pimba av, nonamba manimani honamba pethariniva mueisowa velmba vev.
Wo indkumbiva yimba himba nomba osva ningvrava, kava lehra keknam kavna kelsra lohv, novnovhora vivm, ata homeis yem weral vungu vevm mana vemakoklara.

Manimani yemba temba newondmomba ishunvnamba, nomba indanamba owai, snamba yemba mongo indanam, hindmba monglamba indanam. Heva os keknam yeoa Sesoamangas amnavm. Si osva himba yemba nombolvramoa, sahonamba velmba. Heva os yemba nonamba newondmonamba ishomnavrava, si osva Sesoava yemba monamba indanam vuenghamnavav. Wo si osva yimba beswonamangas avav indkoklahui.
Pol Unna, Yeoa Avm Ehalla, Tihsongomba Okolawolalmoa.
Seh, yeoa avm ehalla, tihsongomba sembayangnamba okolawolalmoa, osva temba Israelnindva vivnamba.
Yimba pev nonora av, yeoa hillivm, kava es ov.

Pimba Sesoam os olvohmanav, yimba lehra, hona mendeklina kaprava, memba himba awothonamba. Manara, pimba mongawatindilm moakot wohvev, tovolva Kristusna dahalliniva. Wo rotiva eva nomba memba pimba popowol vivpa, pimba mongawulm moakot vev Kristusna nihilla.
Mongal rotiva. Wo eva pimba mindnam indhanamba av. Heva os pimba vrav rotiva noi mongasal. Wo noinda osva heni eva indanamba pimba, pimba mongawanind.
Nom ninginu Israelnindm, tatashindva himba hlav no altasengriniva. Wo osva himba Sesoamongo akiliha velm vev.
Heva os manam yimba osva ningvav, kava onengv, os puehalnindna tatasowava tanamolnam, temba himba sengrava velaiheinvpa Sesoadaspolmba. Sesoadaspolmba tanamolnamba owai.

Heva os kava os ov, manimani temba puehalnindva sengrava teihinvpa, nonamba okolawolalmba Sesoadaspolmba, himba maim titnam vinvna tihsongom, Sesoamba owai. Kava yemba ovunv, ata engalsuvvav hem. Manara, ata ye tihsongom okolawol vivav hemongo.
Ata ye hlavra os, vevra, mendeklina kaprini, eva tihsongona kaprini. Yimba hlavramoa, osva vevra, mendeklina meyarini eva tihsongona meyasrini. Indkokla vev osva.
Es hevpa pimba osm vivm, mendeklimoa noinda wusprora? Pimba keknamba avmoa, snamba himba memba.
Osangas Avm, Sesoana Undnangas

Yimba monglava os uv, manam manam pimba ovopulva luhunvmoa, velmba. Kava yemba os unv, heva os manimani besalva owai, luhunvmoa, pimba velmba. Yimba monglava os uv, pimba manam manam luhunv, vewuvmonalmangas. Kava yemba os unv, lehra, heva os owai, manimani kolvrowol vevavmoa, monglamba pholmba nonapopolmba keknamba.
Mongova himba nomba osva vevavmoa mana vemava, hevmangasmba nonamba kolvralmba. Himba heva osm vevra, nomba mana vemava, beswonam owalmba lehra vethangu vevra.
Hlavm manatata manatata, nomba tatamba temba maketrava wulpra vrevpa, Sesoadaspolna sengsrini. Manam yimba sahowol vivra tatarava, wo eva manam yimba ningvra, kava memba indkokla viv, owai.
Yeoa hlao, manara noinda, Sesoana tombaimorava os novol velohv,

content.text: Petha eva manimani memba nosrava lohvpa, mendeklina. Buk Song 24:1

content: Wo himba nomba undnahonamba keknamba lohmba owai vevrava, osva himba das ovravra, wainelm yemba. Yimba domba galmba vevrava, wohnengas vevm, nooa temba murapetava yeindava dembhivrava. Manam yimba sahowol vev, nomba temba yimba nonglavrava.

Heva os mongova indhanariniva ishomnatava yemba, osva nomba innemba doa sengra tihsongom nona okuli, wo manam yimba nomba innemba nevav. Manam yimba nevav, manara noinda, no indhanariniva, temba himba nomba yemba ishomniva, osva memba tihsongona sengsrini. Ata homeis yem nengmanavm, os indkokla vev.

Kava memba osmba ovmoa, yimba nengvra, osva kava memba indkokla vev. Heva os ata homeis nomba indhanariniva yemba nengmanavra, yimba sahonam vev honamba. Dihi yimba kam ishumniv, osva memba pivm pimba ollawol vivpa, mana vemam besalm velmba, wo plalva mongona indhanarini-ina lohv, memba besal osva?
Owai, pivva Sesoam ishumnivrava, yimba lehra, wo hlavra, wo es hevpa besalma, mongova indhanariniva pimba ishunvra, yimba indkokla viv?
Kava Polva yemba os unv, yimba pona innenamba hlavrava, mana vemamba vivrava, yeoa manimani viwul vevm, osm indhanamba Sesoamba si os okulivra.
Yeoa ninginvm indhanam indkumbim, vei, Yutanindm, puehalnindm, eva pevm Sesoanindm. Snawevsanamba manam yimba vinvav, ata homeis himba sahonam vivm Sesoana novrava.
Kava osangas wohvaomana vevna nongas, indkolava nunglivnamba, wohvreivna besal. Kava kavmangasva duus vrevmoa. Kava honamba osm vevna, hemoa indkumbimoa lopshawol vera.
